text: The authors summarize Irving et al.'s debate proposal and its central assumption that telling the truth is easier than lying, and describe the MNIST experiments, where debaters boost a sparse classifier's accuracy, as promising initial results. They state that more research is needed to determine whether debate is a scalable alignment approach.
title: Leike et al. find Irving et al.'s MNIST debate results promising but not proof that debate scales
